editorial.blurb: Great Sea is a beloved Chinese spot in Albany Park serving massive portions of boldly flavored food, anchored by their famous lollipop chicken wings.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the lollipop wings spicy and ask for them just slightly less crispy if you prefer them tender; they're what the place is known for and reviewers rave about the sauce.

topDishes.note: Crispy, tender, and coated in a phenomenal spicy sauce; the star of the menu
Served in the same special sauce as the wings, generously portioned
